h0_discrete_decision_rule.boundary_and_tie_rule: Inclusive conservative discrete rule on integer total false alarms S = sum(k_m): s_lo = max{s : P_hat(S <= s) <= 0.025}, s_hi = min{s : P_hat(S >= s) <= 0.025}. Reject H_0 iff S_obs <= s_lo or S_obs >= s_hi. No randomized tie-breaking.
